    31	without third readers of both families (no one-reader fallback).

    34	how many failing sends recurred, against each denominator). Nothing is concluded about which reading is right or about how much of

    38	recur, and the same packets in the same order, so shared order effects can make agreement look stronger; the briefs as used. Reader sessions are outside every ledger ($0).
